# Code Review Standards

All code merged to the main branch is reviewed.

## Approvals

Changes to services tagged tier-0 require two approvals, one of them from a code owner. Other services need one approval.

## Size

Pull requests should stay under 400 changed lines. Larger changes should be split or come with a design document.

## Turnaround

Reviewers respond within one business day. A reviewer who cannot respond in time reassigns the review.
